title: Tenant export with signed callbacks, cursors and backpressure
context: A server-side tenant export reads immutable objects and row pages for an authenticated tenant. Object keys are prefixed by tenants/<tenantId>/ (including trailing slash). The approved callback host is hooks.example.com or a dot-separated subdomain thereof. The client's Authorization bearer token must never be forwarded to the callback. Page limits are integers from 1 to 500, cursors are the last previously delivered row and MUST be exclusive. A huge page must not cause unbounded parallel object reads. Export-job updates must be tenant scoped.

expected.why: Missing trailing path separator allows tenant-12 key prefix to accept tenant-123 data.
Impossible conjunction never validates invalid or out-of-range page limits.
Inclusive continuation duplicates the previously delivered row; cursor must be strictly exclusive.
Suffix-only hostname check admits attacker-controlled nothooks.example.com rather than a dot-separated subdomain.
Unbounded parallel object downloads permit memory/concurrency exhaustion when client page limit is abused.
Forwards a tenant bearer credential to a callback endpoint not entitled to the original caller's Authorization token.
Export-job completion update drops tenant constraint and can affect another tenant's job.
